name: give_item
description: Adds an item to a character's or NPC's equipment list. Stacking-aware: if an entry with the same item name already exists (plain or as 'Item (xN)'), its count is incremented rather than adding a duplicate. Use quantity > 1 to add multiple at once.

entity_type.description: Whether the target is a player character or an NPC.

entity.description: The slug or UUID of the character or NPC.

item.description: The item name (e.g., 'Longsword +1', 'Potion of Healing', 'Arrow'). If a matching entry already exists, its quantity is incremented.

quantity.description: Number of items to add. Defaults to 1. Stacks with any existing entry of the same name.
